resume_brief: You are the coordinator for the free-3D-pipeline mission. Owner order (Real, 2026-10-16 ~00:10 EDT): he built a bunch of Western Heart models in Tripo Studio and can no longer export them (Tripo locked free exports). He wants (a) the workaround to get his models out, and/or (b) something even better than Tripo that is free — built the REAL way, production-grade 2026 dev tools, not the easy lazy way. He must be able to make models AND export them, forever, at $0. TRACK 1 — RECOVER HIS TRIPO MODELS: research the known workaround. Concrete lead (web-verified 2026-10-16): GitHub thenobody0817/tripo3d-model-downloader — a Violentmonkey/Tampermonkey userscript that captures models from studio.tripo3d.ai with multi-format capture plus free in-browser GLB conversion to STL/OBJ/FBX/3MF/GLTF. Also a YouTube method 'Download Any Tripo AI 3D Model For FREE, No Tools No Extensions' (2026-10-12). Technical note: Tripo's download runs through a client-side blob URL revoked on click — the model data IS in the browser, so interception is the mechanism. Test the userscript approach, verify recovered models open correctly (Blender/GLB), document the exact recovery recipe. His models are HIS — recovering his own work is the job. TRACK 2 — BUILD THE REAL FREE PIPELINE: production-grade, $0 forever, no paywall, no export lock. 2026 open landscape (web-verified): Hunyuan3D 2.1 (best open quality, PBR materials, needs ~24GB VRAM), TRELLIS.2 (best image-to-3D, MIT, ~16GB VRAM, arbitrary topology, native PBR), TripoSR (fastest, ~6GB VRAM, MIT, vertex-colors only). Proven pattern: TripoSR for fast iteration, TRELLIS.2/Hunyuan3D for final quality — architect the pipeline MODEL-SWAPPABLE, never load-bearing on one model. There is an existing repo: mhvnsnt/Forge3D — the owner's free Tripo-rival repo with pipeline stages, TripoSR, Blender 4.2 rig stage, Instant Meshes, anatomy gates, Tripo Studio-style web UI. It has been under GENERATION FREEZE since 2026-10-07 (owner: no new generations until the pipeline is 400% better). This order SUPERSEDES the freeze for pipeline construction — but do NOT mass-generate models; build and prove the pipeline with a few test generations, owner approves every model before it ships. Requirements: image/text-to-3D, PBR texturing, quad remesh, auto-rig to the Western Heart skeleton, GLB/FBX/OBJ export that HE can run (Colab recipe + local GPU docs — the sandbox has no 6GB+ GPU; the pipeline must run where he has hardware). NO paid APIs, NO API keys, MIT/Apache-2.0 licenses only. NO-SHORTCUTS and NO-HAND-TOOLING laws: use the best open models and proven tooling, not hacks; if the proper way takes longer, take it. CHECKPOINT-FIRST: FIRST action writes ~/workspace/agent-ops/checkpoints/forge3d-pipeline-worker.json with full schema, heartbeat updated_at every 15 min, commit incrementally to the Forge3D repo (branch → PR → merge when green). DISK: /home/hatch was ~72% with an 88% hard ceiling — model weights are GBs; document weight sources, keep one active weight set local, stream everything else. NEVER-KILL-IN-PROGRESS: the Drive-to-GitHub move lane and T6-PS3 lane are active — do not touch their work. DELIVERABLES TO PARENT: (1) his Tripo models recovered + verified openable, with the recipe; (2) the working free pipeline in Forge3D with a proven end-to-end run (input image → textured GLB → rigged); (3) docs he can follow on his own hardware. Parent eyes-verifies outputs before they reach him.
